label: MRtrix3 dwi2mask
description:
Generates a whole brain mask from a DWI image
All diffusion weighted and b=0 volumes are used to obtain a mask that includes both brain tissue and CSF.
In a second step peninsula-like extensions, where the peninsula itself is wider than the bridge connecting it to the mask, are removed. This may help removing artefacts and non-brain parts, e.g. eyes, from the mask.

parameters.label: 梯度来源
parameters.description: 自动模式优先使用图像内嵌梯度；缺少内嵌信息时使用与该影像配套的外部梯度。内容在dry-run核验。显式外部来源会覆盖内嵌信息。
parameters.condition_help: MIF格式支持内嵌梯度，但扩展名本身不证明含有梯度；自动选择结果在预检中显示。

parameters.label: clean_scale
parameters.description: the maximum scale used to cut bridges. A certain maximum scale cuts bridges up to a width (in voxels) of 2x the provided scale. Setting this to 0 disables the mask cleaning step. (Default: 2)
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。

parameters.label: quiet

input_slots.label: input
input_slots.description: the input DWI image containing volumes that are both diffusion weighted and b=0

input_slots.label: grad
input_slots.description: Provide the diffusion-weighted gradient scheme used in the acquisition in a text file. This should be supplied as a 4xN text file with each line is in the format [ X Y Z b ], where [ X Y Z ] describe the direction of the applied gradient, and b gives the b-value in units of s/mm^2. If a diffusion gradient scheme is present in the input image header, the data provided with this option will be instead used.
input_slots.condition_help: 条件必需；自动选择图像内嵌梯度时不读取、不传入此输入。外部bval与bvec必须配套，显式指定时覆盖内嵌梯度。

input_slots.label: fslgrad_bvecs
input_slots.description: Provide the diffusion-weighted gradient scheme used in the acquisition in FSL bvecs/bvals format files. If a diffusion gradient scheme is present in the input image header, the data provided with this option will be instead used.
